requiredBundle: vendor paid-invoice SHA-256 and exact cost fields
Stripe settlement SHA-256 and actual fee
optionalProofLink: physicalProofId is allowed only when the same Edition exists as a Human-approved record in proof-evidence-ledger.json.
uniqueness: Duplicate evidenceId, order-reference HMAC, CAC cohort ID or paid-customer HMAC is rejected.
privacy: No Stripe ID, customer identity, address, tracking number, invoice body or free text is stored in the ledger.

registration.dryRun: Add --dry-run to validate the complete merged ledger without writing it.
registration.writeSafety: The command rejects unknown or privacy-sensitive fields, duplicate evidence IDs, duplicate underlying-order HMACs and mismatched proof links; it writes a mode-0600 pending file and atomically renames only after all validation passes.
registration.humanGate: The exact per-order Human approval token is mandatory and is not generated by automation.
registration.privacyTransformation: Internal order and tracking references are converted with domain-separated HMAC-SHA-256. Evidence files are converted to SHA-256. Raw references, source paths and file bodies are omitted from the candidate.

claimBoundary: This proves the evidence contract and rejection controls, not a paid order, invoice, shipment, delivery, physical proof or observed margin.
